archetypes.name: collector-sentinel-vars
archetypes.rationale: The plan's pseudocode for the always-on sentinel detection in collect-agent-results.sh uses variable names that do not match the actual first-pass build loop, and the RESULTS[j]= assignment pattern is inconsistent with the append-only loop structure — a silent no-op risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read scripts/collect-agent-results.sh at lines 700-850 and identify the exact variable names used inside the first-pass file-processing loop (the loop that builds the RESULTS array via RESULTS+=). Compare them against the plan's pseudocode, which references $REVIEWER_FILE and $ENTRY_TOOL and uses RESULTS[j]= (index assignment). Determine whether those variable names are in scope at the proposed insertion point, or whether they belong to a later loop over already-collected RESULTS. Also check whether RESULTS[j]= (assigning to an index j) is semantically equivalent to the plan's intent: if j is undefined or zero, this silently overwrites RESULTS[0] instead of adding a new entry. Verify the plan's claimed 'continue' bypass skips the correct RESULTS+= line and does not leave the reviewer absent from the output entirely. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: test-scope-completeness
archetypes.rationale: The plan's acceptance criteria AC 8 and AC 9 require new test cases in scripts/test-collect-agent-bash32.sh and scripts/test-validate-research-output.sh, but those files are absent from the reviewer file list — meaning the plan commits to ACs it cannot satisfy within the declared scope.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the reviewer file list against the plan's acceptance criteria sections AC 8 (Case 5b in scripts/test-collect-agent-bash32.sh) and AC 9 (Case 19g in scripts/test-validate-research-output.sh). Confirm whether those files appear in the file list; if they do not, flag that the plan's ACs exceed its own stated scope. Also read scripts/test-ship-pr.sh around line 3644 to verify that the vendor_verify_sweep_regression test's exit-4 and STALL_STEP=10-max-retries assertions are reachable when ship-pr.sh is invoked directly with STUB_LINT_FIX_STATUS=main-agent-required, --state-file, and TRANSIENT_RETRIES=1/FAILED_RUN_ID=run123 pre-seeded in the state file — the helper-stub previously called run_evaluate_failure directly, bypassing the full ship-pr.sh dispatch path. Verify the plan's description of this rewrite is consistent with how ship-pr.sh actually enters the CI-stall path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
